project_identity.name: Aptimizer
project_identity.type: Civil Engineering & Real Estate Planning Platform (Data-Dense SaaS)
project_identity.target_audience: Civil engineers, structural engineers, architects, real estate developers, urban planners
project_identity.tone: Authoritative, mathematically precise, zero-assumption, high-density, technical blueprint aesthetic
project_identity.core_mission: Transform plot boundaries into fully compliant, code-verified development schemes with zero assumptions and complete auditability across all 22 workspace modules.

typography.strategy: Swiss Technical Engineering Blueprint - absolute legibility, high contrast, crisp monospaced numeric data.

colors.archetype: Swiss High-Contrast Engineering (Authority, Precision, Blueprint Clarity)

scroll_animation_spec.technology: Framer Motion + Canvas 2D requestAnimationFrame scrub render
stability_optimizations: Image preloading into in-memory HTMLImageElement cache map to eliminate flicker
BoundingClientRect-based scroll progress calculation to replace stale cached useScroll targets
DPR-aware canvas scale rendering (capped at 2x) with cover fit
Nearest-decoded-frame fallback logic to prevent blank canvas when frames decode asynchronously
Lead-in threshold (0.06) holding clean blueprint paper before scrubbing starts
prefers-reduced-motion fallback to static SVG Blueprint component

key_features: Real-time search bar filtering across parameter names, codes, units, and formulas
Filter pills for Parameter Type (Configured, Estimated, Computed, Derived)
Module group selector (Site, Design, Engineering & BIM, Cost & Procurement, Deliver & ESG)
Detailed view showing exact formula, unit, IS/NBC clause citation, and tolerance/validation limit
Distinction badges between configured inputs, computed values, and estimated heuristics

layouts.overall: Mode B High-Density Engineering Grid for Workspace, Mode A Tetris & Bento Grid for Landing Page.
layouts.spacing: Tight internal padding (p-3 to p-5) for workspace widgets to maximize data density. Generous section padding (py-20 to py-28) for landing page storytelling.
layouts.cards: Flat solid surfaces with subtle hairline borders (1px border-slate-200). Semi-solid background for headers (`bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm`). No fully transparent headers.
layouts.sidebar: Clean white sidebar (`bg-white border-r border-slate-200`) or dark slate sidebar (`bg-slate-950`).
layouts.metrics_strip: Vertical or horizontal metrics strip with JetBrains Mono numbers, status badges (Saved / Saving / Retrying), and role badges.

components.data_tables: Shadcn UI table primitives with compact padding, numeric right-alignment, and JetBrains Mono monospace digits.
components.forms_inputs: Shadcn UI Form, Input, Select, and Slider components with primary focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-600`).
components.charts: Recharts and Shadcn Chart wrappers using structural engineering color schemes (blue, slate, emerald, amber).
components.compliance_panel: Rule-by-rule status list with Pass/Fail/Warning badges, clause numbers, and margin remaining metrics.
components.buttons: ReactiveButton and standard Shadcn Button with active press states and hover highlights.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid borders with hairline 1px dividers (`gap-px bg-slate-200`) creating structured bento layouts.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Crystal Glass style for sticky headers and modals: `bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm border-b border-slate-200`. Never fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.textures: SVG technical blueprint grid overlay for canvas and hero sections.

motion.scroll_scrubbing: Framer Motion useScroll + Canvas requestAnimationFrame for frame sequence.
motion.micro_interactions: Smooth state transitions on buttons and cards using specific CSS properties (transform, opacity, color), avoiding universal `transition: all`.
motion.page_reveal: Framer Motion Stagger and Reveal animation wrappers for smooth content entrance.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA and APCA compliant contrast across all light and dark sections.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Complete motion disablement or static blueprint fallback when `prefers-reduced-motion` is active.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements and key data fields must include kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.

hero_poster.description: 3D massing and architectural model render poster

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.jsx / .js) files for all React components.
Maintain the established Work Sans and JetBrains Mono identity and blue engineering branding.
Ensure all calculations in the app differentiate configured vs estimated vs computed values.
Implement the searchable 22-module parameter directory on the landing page with filter pills.
Keep the scroll animation smooth using preloaded frame images and canvas requestAnimationFrame rendering.
Add explicit `data-testid` attributes to every new interactive component.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for header, overlays, or dropdown menus.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Ensure all data cells and table headers are properly aligned.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them.
